name: approval-buttons
title: Approval buttons
description: Approve and Reject as one decision: a reason when rejecting, who decided and when, and a short window to change your mind.
docs: Uncontrolled it runs by itself: Approve and Reject call onApprove and onReject (each may return a promise and shows its own busy and error state), then the status line takes over with Change decision for undoWindow seconds. Controlled, pass status, decidedBy, decidedAt and reason, and set status back to pending in onChangeDecision. Reject always asks for a reason first (requireReason makes it required). Pass locale and timeZone so the time reads the same on the server and in the browser. A decision made here shows just the time on the day it was made and adds the date on any other day; a time you pass in decidedAt always carries its date, so a page rendered on the server reads the same once it has loaded. In a narrow space Change decision drops under the sentence. The control holds no form of its own, so it can sit inside yours, and Ctrl or Cmd with Enter confirms a rejection.
